suppress.notes: CVE-2026-53914: "JetBrains Kotlin before 2.4.20, code execution via unsafe deserialization in the build cache metadata". The vulnerable code is in the compiler's build-cache handling, which runs on the build machine; the scanner matches the shared Kotlin CPE onto kotlin-stdlib, which ships in the APK but does not contain that code. Exposure on the build machine needs write access to the local Gradle cache. Mitigation until Kotlin >= 2.4.20: no remote or shared Gradle build cache. Owner accepted 2026-10-29; revisit with the toolchain bump (follow-up plan).

androidx.sqlite (sqlite, sqlite-android, sqlite-framework, sqlite-framework-android) 2.5.0 is AndroidX's Kotlin/Java wrapper API over SQLite, and "2.5.0" is the wrapper's own version. The scanner matches it to the CPE of the SQLite *engine* (sqlite:sqlite:2.5.0, a release from the early 2000s) and reports that engine's whole CVE history (CVE-2015-3414 ... CVE-2025-6965). None of that code is in these jars. The engine in use is the platform's SQLite (patched by OS updates; minSdk 33) until A4b swaps in SQLCipher 4.7.2, which bundles its own SQLite. A4b result (2026-10-30): the engine in the app is now the one inside libsqlcipher.so of sqlcipher-android 4.7.2, SQLite 3.49.1, which is older than 3.50.2 (CVE-2025-6965). The scanner cannot see inside native libraries, so it reports nothing for it; this suppression still says nothing about the engine. The app only runs its own static, parameterised SQL, so those CVEs (they need crafted SQL) are not reachable today; sqlcipher-android 4.10.0 bundles 3.50.4 and is the way to remove the question (owner decision, see docs/architecture/persistence-and-security.md). Added by the A4a developer; the owner decides whether to accept (docs/TECHNICAL.md section 5). Expires so it comes back for review before the H3 release work.

CVE-2020-29582 (JetBrains Kotlin before 1.4.21: insecure temp file creation in the Java API used by the standard library). It is fixed in 1.4.21, and the affected artifacts here are kotlin-stdlib-jdk7 and -jdk8 1.8.20 (transitive of AndroidX; in these versions the jdk7/jdk8 artifacts are empty shims that forward to kotlin-stdlib). The scanner's CPE match ignores the fixed-in version. Added by the A4a developer; the owner decides whether to accept.
